title: Izina ryahawe imbere y'uko umuntu avuka
intro: Iyumvire ahantu heranda h’agacerere kuzuye ugusenga n’ubwira inyuma y’imyaka myinshi y’ugutegerezwa. Mu bitaboneka ni ho hava inyishu itwara izina ritigeze rivugwa, isezerana ubwenge bwo mu myaka ya mbere n’ubuzima burangwa n’ukwihebera Imana, impukwe n’ubugororotsi.
clues: Narizwe na Allah ubwiwe imbere y’uko mvuka, n’izina ritarigeze ryitirirwa umuntu n’umwe imbere yanje.
Narahawe nk’inyishu y’ugutakamba n’umwete abavyeyi bageze mu zabukuru biyumvira ko uruvyaro rudashoboka.
Nahawe ubwenge, guca imanza n’Ivyanditswe nkiri muto.
Nari umuntu afise inshingano ku bavyeyi banje kandi akagira impuhwe ku bandi, kandi sinagira ubwibone canke uwutumvira.
Allah yategetse amahoro kuri jewe umusi navukiyeko, umusi nzopfa, n’umusi nzozuka ndi muzima.
Dawe Zakariyya yararonse inkuru nziza y’ivyanje ivuye ku bamarayika igihe yari ahagaze mu gusenga mu rusengero (mihrab).

Ihabwa abavyeyi bageze mu zabukuru bamaze gusenga bimwe bivuye ku mutima .
Yarahanganye na Farawoni maze arongora urugendo rwo kujabuka ikiyaga .
trial.answer: Ihabwa abavyeyi bageze mu zabukuru bamaze gusenga bimwe bivuye ku mutima .

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَـٰمٌۭ وَقَدْ بَلَغَنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ وَٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرٌۭ ۖ قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱللَّهُ يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشَآءُ
verse: He said, "My Lord, how will I have a boy when I have reached old age and my wife is barren?" He [the angel] said, "Such is Allāh; He does what He wills." (3:40)
